facts.activity_file: removing isolation and returning to operations

assets.label: hydrocarbon day tanks and surge vessel
assets.service: diesel and light hydrocarbon day storage, discharge surge suppression

consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: mechanical support of a load during maintenance access
application of positive isolation devices and personal locks
dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: audit finding - spot check of key safeguard at V-4110

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control LOAD_SUPPORT_FOR_MAINTENANCE: the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access had been bypassed, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control POSITIVE_ISOLATION_APPLICATION: the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks had been bypassed, and the accident investigation classified this as an individual or team action.

Control STORED_ENERGY_DISSIPATION: the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was in place but did not perform, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access on V-4110 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
Restore the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy on V-4110 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in restoring plant to service, specifically removing isolation and returning to operations. V-4110 (hydrocarbon day tanks and surge vessel) is in service for diesel and light hydrocarbon day storage, discharge surge suppression. The task proceeded during a statutory inspection while the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access had been bypassed. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 13 November 2009 a planned spot check of V-4110 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility found the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access not effective.
